verdict.rationale: OpenHands' pricing page says both the Open Source and Cloud plans support bringing your own LLM keys. The GitHub README says it can be used with any LLM, and the SDK's agent settings define which model an agent uses, so the engineering lead chooses the model. missing for 10: detailed setup docs for API keys and supported providers, independent or hands-on corroboration that BYO keys work as described.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can bring my own LLM or API key so agents run on the model of my choice

citations.quote: OpenHands Open Source and OpenHands Cloud plans offer support to bring your own LLM keys.
`OpenHandsAgentSettings` gives you a structured, serializable way to define an agent's model, tools, and optional subsystems like the condenser.
